chattoolkit.config.title: Chat Toolkit Settings
chattoolkit.config.subtitle: Changes apply right away
chattoolkit.config.option.search_bar.too: Show the search box under the chat. Ctrl+F jumps into it.
chattoolkit.config.option.search_width.t: Match the width of the chat, or stretch across the screen like the chat input.
chattoolkit.config.option.match_chat_opa: Give the search bar the same background as the chat box. Change it in Chat Settings with "Text Background Opacity".
chattoolkit.config.option.lift_chat.tool: In survival, the chat and search bar move up so they don't cover your hearts, armor or hunger. In creative they stay where they are.
chattoolkit.config.option.chat_offset.to: Moves the chat up by this much more, in every game mode.
chattoolkit.config.option.remember_searc: Put your last search back when you open the chat again.
chattoolkit.config.option.case_sensitive: "Steve" won't match "steve". Same as the Aa button in the search bar.
chattoolkit.config.option.whole_words.to: "iron" won't match "environment". Same as the W button.
chattoolkit.config.option.regex.tooltip: Treat the search as a regex, like (diamond|emerald)s?. Same as the .* button.
chattoolkit.config.option.history_size.t: How many messages the chat keeps (vanilla keeps 100). More history means more to search.
Background opacity of the right-click menu, pinned notes and this screen. Only used for the search bar if "Match chat opacity" is off.
chattoolkit.config.option.accent_color.t: Used for search highlights and command results. Pick a swatch or type a hex color.
chattoolkit.config.option.highlight_opac: How strongly search matches are highlighted in the chat.
chattoolkit.config.option.hover_highligh: Lightly highlights the message under your mouse so you can see which one a right-click will pick.
chattoolkit.config.option.context_menu.t: Right-click a chat message to copy it, paste it into your chat box, message the sender, copy links or coordinates, or save it as a note.
chattoolkit.config.option.middle_click_c: Middle-click a message to copy it right away.
chattoolkit.config.option.show_timestamp: The right-click menu shows when the message arrived.
chattoolkit.config.option.override_clien: When Client Commands is installed, use this mod's /ccalc and /cnote instead of its own. Turn off to keep theirs and use /ctk calc and /ctk note for these.
chattoolkit.config.option.calc_angles.to: Units for sin, cos, tan and their inverses.
The most decimal places a result shows. Rounding noise like 0.30000000000000004 is always cleaned up.
chattoolkit.config.option.calc_separator: Show 1,234,567 instead of 1234567. Copied results never include them.
chattoolkit.config.option.calc_stacks.to: For whole numbers of 64 or more, also show shulker boxes, stacks and items.
chattoolkit.config.option.pinned_hud.too: Show pinned notes (/cnotes pin) and running timers (/ctimer) on screen. Open the chat to drag them around.
chattoolkit.config.option.hud_corner.too: Which corner the pinned panel starts in. You can also drag the panel anywhere while the chat is open, and right-click it to send it back to this corner.
chattoolkit.config.option.timer_sound.to: Play a chime when a timer finishes.
chattoolkit.config.option.edit_tabs.tool: Name your tabs, pick which messages each one shows, and save presets for different servers.
chattoolkit.config.option.tabs_enabled.t: Turn chat tabs on or off. With them off the chat works like normal.
chattoolkit.config.option.tabs_help.tool: A quick explanation of tabs, windows and presets.
chattoolkit.tabs.title: Chat tabs
chattoolkit.tabs.pop_out: Pop out into its own window
chattoolkit.tabs.tab_hint: Click to open. Right-click for options
chattoolkit.tabs.name: Name
chattoolkit.tabs.everything_else_hint: Anything the other tabs don't catch
chattoolkit.tabs.no_rules: No rules yet, so this tab stays empty
chattoolkit.tabs.last_tab: You need at least one tab
chattoolkit.tabs.not_on_server: You're not on a server right now
chattoolkit.tabs.last_preset: You need at least one preset
chattoolkit.tabs.copied: Copied. Paste it to a friend
chattoolkit.tabs.paste_failed: Your clipboard doesn't have a preset in it
chattoolkit.tabs.help.title: How to use tabs
chattoolkit.tabs.help.step1.text: Open chat with T. The tabs sit on top of the message box. Click one to only see those messages.
chattoolkit.tabs.help.step2.text: A red dot on a tab means something new came in there.
chattoolkit.tabs.help.step3.text: Hover a tab and click the little arrow. Drag the window anywhere by its title. Drag it back onto the tabs (or click its x) to put it back.
chattoolkit.tabs.help.step4.text: Settings > Edit tabs. Type the tag the server puts in front of the message, with its & color codes.
chattoolkit.tabs.help.step5.text: Saves your whole tab setup. SRP default comes built in. Set a server address and it loads when you join.
chattoolkit.tabs.help.tip: Tip: right-click a message > Copy with colors to grab its tag.
chattoolkit.tabs.export.tooltip: Saves this preset as a .json file in config/chattoolkit/presets
chattoolkit.tabs.import.tooltip: Pick a preset file from config/chattoolkit/presets
chattoolkit.tabs.no_files: No preset files in the folder yet
chattoolkit.tabs.import_hint: Put .json preset files in the presets folder, or drag them onto the game window while this screen is open.
chattoolkit.config.option.stack_messages: When the same message comes in again, the old copy is replaced with one line and a count, like (x12). Hover the count to see when it started.
chattoolkit.config.option.stack_window.t: How long a message can be repeated after and still stack. Set to the left for any time.
chattoolkit.config.option.unread_separat: When you open a tab with a red dot, a red line shows where the messages you haven't seen start.
chattoolkit.tabs.menu.dock: Put back in the tab bar
chattoolkit.window.title: %s window
chattoolkit.config.option.screenshot_toa: Show a notification instead of a chat message
After taking a screenshot, a small card slides in at the top right with a preview. Open the chat to use its Open, Copy and Folder buttons.
chattoolkit.config.option.screenshot_mut: Don't play a sound when the notification shows up.
chattoolkit.config.option.screenshot_sec: How long the notification stays before sliding away. It waits while your mouse is on it.
